lesson-intro.text: Deep in caves, crystals grow in clusters, all reaching for the light. These five sprout from one rock, each with a bright side and a dark side. Watch them grow, then start a cluster of your own.

rock.text: The crystals grow out of a low rock. From the top, draw one half, then the other, flat along the bottom.

middle.text: The middle crystal stands straight up, like a fat pencil. Then one line down its middle.

inner.text: The next two lean out a little on each side. Give each its line down the middle.

outer.text: Two more lean out further, the shortest of all. That makes five crystals.

light.text: The light catches the left side of every crystal. Color those blue.

dark.text: The right sides are in shadow. Color them purple.

lesson-outro.text: Five crystals, every one with a light side and a dark side. That's a trick you can use on anything you draw.
